source_basis.note: Endpoint states, minimum effort fields, matched PERSON_MINUTES_V1 effort, the candidate-level arm-specific analysis unit, repeated-visit aggregation, shared-candidate handling, and no-skip frozen-order assignment are all frozen before prospective outcomes are opened.

newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.success_numerator: count of resolved COHORT_ARM_CANDIDATE_V1 analysis units classified SEARCH_COMPLETED_DETECTED_VERIFIED under the frozen repeated-visit rule
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.identity_unresolved_handling: report separately; exclude from the resolved binary denominator until identity is resolved by the predeclared verification process; never recode as absence
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.non_biological_negative_handling: report separately; exclude from the biological detection/non-detection denominator; never recode as absence
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.primary_between_arm_contrast: difference in verified-current-occurrence success proportion between the frozen primary method and each frozen comparator, evaluated only under the pre-outcome matched-effort allocation schedule

effort_accounting.reason_pending: The candidate-specific visit allocation and numerical person-minute schedule cannot be instantiated until the still-missing private range-sector geometry produces exact frozen candidate identities.
effort_accounting.forbidden_inference: Do not change the person-minute metric, choose a new effort threshold, visit count, stopping rule, or favorable subset after field outcomes are opened.

schedule_selection_mechanics.rule: For each cohort unit and method arm, the unique scheduled candidate references must be a no-skip prefix of the exact hash-verified frozen arm order. Repeat visits may repeat a candidate already inside that prefix.

analysis_unit_and_repeated_visits.primary_analysis_unit_definition: one unique cohort_unit_id x method_arm x private_candidate_ref selected by the frozen pre-outcome schedule; all scheduled visits to that arm-specific candidate aggregate into this single primary analysis unit
analysis_unit_and_repeated_visits.repeated_visit_aggregation_rule: Within one COHORT_ARM_CANDIDATE_V1 unit, any SEARCH_COMPLETED_DETECTED_VERIFIED visit makes the unit a verified detection success. If no verified detection occurs, classify the unit SEARCH_COMPLETED_NOT_DETECTED only when every scheduled visit is SEARCH_COMPLETED_NOT_DETECTED. Identity-unresolved or non-biological/non-evaluable visits never become absence; without a verified detection they keep the unit outside the resolved binary denominator.
analysis_unit_and_repeated_visits.shared_candidate_handling_rule: If the same physical candidate is selected by multiple frozen arms, retain one arm-specific analysis unit in every nominating arm; do not drop, substitute, or assign exclusive ownership. A single physical search may supply the same observed biological outcome to each nominating arm-specific unit, while PERSON_MINUTES_V1 is charged to each arm's preregistered counterfactual schedule. Cross-arm candidate overlap must be reported, and summed arm effort must not be interpreted as total expedition effort.
analysis_unit_and_repeated_visits.required_next_gate: Instantiate the candidate-specific visit/allocation and PERSON_MINUTES_V1 schedule after exact candidate identities exist, then publicly pin its hash-only receipt before opening prospective outcomes.

promotion_claim_ceiling.allowed_after_all_pre_outcome_gates_and_: test whether the frozen structural-within-coverage order improves verified current-occurrence recovery relative to frozen comparators at matched person-minute field effort
not_authorized_by_this_contract: discoveries per hour as a validated product claim

pre_outcome_gate_state.next_gate: After private candidate/order freeze and immutable public hash pin, instantiate a no-skip frozen-order schedule with matched PERSON_MINUTES_V1 effort, then publicly pin its receipt before any outcome-opening workflow.
